name: Privatize

web.notes: Frankfurt-based B2B2C private-markets platform for banks (white-label), asset managers/MFOs and financial advisors; ELTIFs from EUR 1,000; digital subscription; custody via partner banks (DAB BNP Paribas, Fondsdepot Bank, UBS, V-Bank). Login/MFA not published.

api.notes: No API or developer documentation found; site says funds are 'seamlessly integrated in client accounts' via partner custody banks.

notes: Added as DACH platform. Confidence: low-medium overall; vendor site is marketing only. Positions are typically booked in the investor's custody account at a partner bank, so position data may be reachable via the bank rather than Privatize. Investor-side API: unknown. Terms not retrievable.
